title: Planning
about: The cards waiting to be started.

terms.meaning: an idea on its way to a run: a short markdown brief in the inbox, started as a run, and kept there after it starts. It names its factory and its workflow, never a repository: the factory's wiring places its run (`nemia factory attach <factory> <workflow> --repo <name>`).

see.label: From a card to a branch

retired.card: inbox: a card names its factory and workflow, never a repository

kept.why: an old card's `repo:` read as written, listed as retired and written back as it was, never to place a run
an old card's `repo:` said as not read at its start (`ignoredRepo`), never to place its run
`nemia inbox queue` prints an old card's `repo:` marked retired, as `nemia inbox` lists it

terms.meaning: a card's name: its file's in the inbox, without its extension, which `nemia inbox` lists and a start names it by; drawn from its first line when it is filed and kept when it is edited (`nemia inbox edit`), so it may no longer read as its title.

where a card is in its life: filed, queued or refused before it starts, and its run's phase once it has (pending, running, waiting, succeeded, failed, stopped, cancelled), read from the run each time the inbox is read and never stored on the card; a card whose run was removed reads filed again. Computed once by the orchestrator and sent on the wire as is.

see.label: From a card to a branch

terms.meaning: where a card stands as a person sorts cards, a summary of its state worked out on every read and never stored: notStarted (filed, nobody started it), blocked (held by cards of its after: that have not succeeded), waiting (on a person: its run waits on one, its queued start was refused, or a card it waits on can only be released by one), working (at work, or queued for room to run), then done, failed and cancelled once its run ended (a stopped run reads cancelled). The first four are open (`CardPhase`, `packages/objects/src/card.ts`).

a card the inbox lists by default (Open on the Inbox page): filed, queued or refused, or started with a run that is pending, running or waiting. A card whose run ended is listed with nemia inbox --all, and under the Inbox page's Closed.

see.label: From a card to a branch

terms.meaning: where cards wait before they are started.

see.label: From a card to a branch

terms.meaning: the tick's start of a queued card that did not happen, as it writes it down: when, on which repository, why, and whether it was a refusal.

see.label: From a card to a branch

retired.card: A card keeps its identity after it starts

terms.meaning: the one way a card of the inbox and the tick's tries of a queued one are read and written: `CardDoor` in `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/cards/cards.store.ts`, by `CardName`, its files layer at the store's root a program is given and a memory one, each refusing a card filed under a name that is no card's, at a name taken, or whose text does not read as a card. One run per card is the Run door's to hold.

the cards a card trigger of their factory queues: each card whose labels its selector selects, not queued by hand and not started, listed `queued` with the triggers that queue it (`queued.by`), on the workflow it names, or on the trigger's target where it names none, ordered with the cards queued by hand by when it was filed. Read on every pass and never written on the card: taking the label off takes it out of the queue (`Triggering`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/inbox/inbox.ts`).

a card naming no workflow that two or more triggers of its factory would send to two workflows: it is listed `filed` with the triggers that clash (`clash`) and waits until a selector or its labels change (`cardTriggered`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/inbox/triggered.ts`).

the files a card carries under its `files:` key, a map of the name its text and its run find each by to the File it names: written only while no run was started from it (`cardFilesRefusal`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/inbox/card-files.ts`), kept by the files' prune while any inbox entry names them, and copied into the inputs folder of every run started from it.

a started card filed again by a person (`nemia inbox resend`) as a card of its own, `<run>-resent`, its body, factory and labels kept and handed the runs it was started as (`from:`), queued on the workflow named or naming none for its factory's card triggers; the run it came from is cancelled when it waits on a person. A card never started, sent on already, or whose run is still at work is refused (`resendRefusal`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/inbox/resend.ts`).

a card not started whose `after:` names a card that has not succeeded: it is listed with each (`waits`, the Card's `status.waitingOn`), queued by no trigger and started by no tick until the last has succeeded. A named card has succeeded when a run started from it has, as `nemia ls` says it, or the card its run passed the work on to has (a workflow node's card, `nemia inbox resend`); a wait on a card the store does not know, on a cycle of `after:`, or at a card whose run ended without succeeding or whose start was refused is stalled, waiting on a person (`nemia release <run>` frees a run's waiters) (`cardReleased`, `waitStalled`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/src/inbox/waits.ts`). A start by hand starts it all the same.
